cards.text: Solomon is Israel's king, and he's asked God for an understanding heart to judge His people (1 Kings 3:9). Now two prostitutes come and stand before him. Friend, this is NOT a parking ticket.

One woman speaks first: she and this woman live in the same house, and three days after she gave birth there, the other woman had a baby too. Two newborns under one roof, and I bet that house was never quiet.

cards.question: The first woman says someone else was staying in the house with the two of them.

cards.text: Friend, this part is hard to hear. During the night, she says, the other woman's son died because his mother rolled over on him.

cards.question: According to the first woman, what did the other woman do in the middle of the night?

answers.text: Swapped her dead son for the living one
Hid her dead son outside the house
Woke the first woman up for help

cards.question: The next morning, the first woman finds a dead baby at her side, but when she looks closer, she realizes he isn't the son she gave birth to.

cards.text: Then the other woman cuts in, and friend, she is NOT having it.

cards.question: The other woman tells the king the ___ one is her son.

cards.text: So they argue right there in front of the king. Solomon sums it up: each woman says the living son is hers and the dead one belongs to the other.

cards.question: Two women, two stories, no witnesses. What does King Solomon call for?

cards.text: So they bring the king a sword. I bet everybody got real QUIET real fast.

cards.question: Solomon orders the living child cut in two, with half going to each woman.

cards.text: Now, I know how that sounds. Then one of the women speaks up to the king: the one whose son is alive.

cards.question: The woman whose son is alive speaks up first. What does she beg the king to do?

answers.text: Give the baby to the other woman
Let the two of them share him
Give her time to find a witness

cards.question: The woman whose son is alive speaks up because she yearned with ___ for her son.

cards.text: Then the other woman answers the king too. And friend, I'm gonna let her words speak for themselves.

cards.question: After the woman whose son is alive offers to give him up, what does the other woman say?

answers.text: Neither of us gets him so cut him
Put the sword away and let us go
Then she can leave my house for good

cards.question: Solomon gives his ruling. Who gets the living baby?

answers.text: The woman who begged to spare him
The woman who said to cut him

cards.question: In his ruling, Solomon says the baby must not be killed, and he says the woman who begged for him is his mother.

cards.text: Word travels faster than a group chat. All Israel hears about the judgment the king gave.

cards.question: When all Israel hears about the king's judgment, they think he is too harsh.
The people saw that the ___ of God was in Solomon to administer justice.
